==Description==
The '''Trapper Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 3 [[Trapper]]. Anybody who buys the toy will be emailed a code 24 hours later which allows them to get the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[Trapper]].

The bear trap of the '''Trapper Plush''' is detachable.  It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 12.6 inches (32 cm) tall, 10.8 inches (27.43 cm) wide and 9.1 inches (23.11 cm) long. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Trapper Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:This intermediate tower with level 4 bear trap is attachable via Velcro. Even hidden enemies can’t escape from these powerful traps.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Trapper Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $29.99. Previously had a cost of $26.99. It is currently unavailable.
